card.name: Split-off F or W starting a word
card.fires_on: A lone letter F or W (capital or lowercase) that begins a word split into pieces, such as F|urthermore, f|ared, w|axy, W|arnings. It appears after a space or a linking word.

modes.label: Split F in sentence openers
modes.description: A separate F begins a word like Furthermore or a name like Floyd.

modes.label: Split W in Warnings cross-references
modes.description: A separate W begins the word Warnings in a bracketed section reference.

modes.label: Split f or w inside ordinary words
modes.description: A lowercase f or w begins words such as fared, waxy or warts.
modes.example: how children throughout the country<< f>>ared in the past few years

card.writes: It seems to push toward word continuations beginning with letters like pres or radio, but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires when the word starts with a stray F or W that the model must finish, like F-urthermore or W-arnings.
